environment.description: Same application packaged as a Lambda function behind a Lambda Function URL. The Function URL is configured with AuthType: AWS_IAM. The Lambda execution role has a resource-based policy that does NOT include a lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission for principal '*' or any aws:principalOrgID condition. The function URL's resource policy contains only an explicit allow for role arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/InternalServiceCallerRole with condition StringEquals on lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType set to AWS_IAM. Unauthenticated HTTP requests to the function URL receive HTTP 403 {"Message":"Forbidden"} from the Lambda service before the function code executes. Additionally, the Lambda runtime uses a read-only filesystem for all paths except /tmp (512MB), and the function runs with a non-root UID in a Firecracker microVM with no network egress (VPC-attached with security group allowing no outbound rules except to the VPC endpoint for CloudWatch Logs).

config.resource_policy: Allow lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl only for arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/InternalServiceCallerRole with StringEquals lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType=AWS_IAM
config.no_public_access: No lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission granted to '*' or anonymous principals
config.network: VPC-attached, security group egress limited to pl-xxxxx (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.logs) on port 443 only
